name: zmath_vec3_rotate_y
description: zMath::Vec3RotateY rotates a vector around the Y axis using x'=sin(yaw)*z+cos(yaw)*x, y'=y, z'=cos(yaw)*z-sin(yaw)*x.
known_limits: VC5SP3 profile sweep on 2026-06-04 over vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_facs, and vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs failed with 117 unmasked mismatches. Binary Ninja body is 119 bytes; VC object symbol is 80 bytes. Retail uses an EBP-frame x87 range-check path with fsin/fcos for small angles and fsincos fallback, while current VC5 sin()/cos() source emits a shorter helper/intrinsic shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x474f40 validate the fastcall/callee-cleaned yaw argument, sin/cos calculation, y passthrough, x/z rotation formulas, and balanced x87 stack.
The native zMath smoke verifies rotating (1,2,3) by pi/2 around Y produces approximately (3,2,-1).
